description: Foresight is embedded in budgets regulation implementation and public learning.
Public agencies produce future-facing reports with little decision influence.
External providers shape future narratives but internal learning remains weak.
Expert-led models dominate while public contestability and justice are weak.
Local innovation grows but national support and capacity equality remain uneven.
Public agencies communities workers and experts co-create foresight and policy learning.
Institutions respond after disruption rather than building standing foresight capacity.
